scope: Before any reader-slot policy return has been scored, bound how much the pending crossed reader answers can change its decision. Use original joint-masked training targets. No bound trains an actor.
calculation: A missing physical hybrid F1 lies in [0,1]. Keep actual endpoint aliases fixed, preserve shared hybrid scores when their hashes match within a question, and compute the two extreme direct two-order contributions. Extra signed credit is monotone in the direct contribution when its sign agrees with total return. Aggregate those training ranges per contrast. Propagate through the exact signed difference of the normalized source and full kernels, native-logit clamp and sigmoid. When bounding a window return, every question at that window shares the same single probability. Permit different windows and donor rows to attain their extrema separately. This relaxation is an outer bound, including for a completed set of globally consistent physical hybrid answers. The partial alias policy is a different fixed model and need not be in that range.
report: On calibration and later panels report the range of possible completed-policy focal F1 and the current gains relative to native and terminal PPO. Check the completed physical predictions are within the precomputed bounds. Small training-history bounds cannot establish independent generalization.
